Well, i guess you can use it to stall Mega Slow in Hardcore solo to make your gems grind less painful i guess, tho, not to flex, but i can get to wave 35 with Ace Pilot+Military Base+Support alone E Tier Mortar This tower is basically Rocketeer, but it can actually be viable early game. However, anywhere other than Lv0 and this tower is not really cost efficient. It is just bad for something you have to grind to lv 75 to get. At least it can be used for early game and Solar Eclipse Night 4. Electroshocker This is basically Freezer, but chainable and can slow enemy a bit more. However, the stun on later wave is just like Freezer. Too short. I know that Electroshocker once can be used for Hidden Wave, but since that is gone, Electroshocker is just... pointless. Damn shame tho, since using this tower feels fun for me. Demoman (After reconsideration i decided to move it to D tier, too lazy to change the tier list) "OH My GoD HoW CoULd YoU pUT DeMOmaN HeRe iTS ThE BeST ToWER In TDs" Haha.... no. Demoman's explosion radius is too small for it to be effective at crowd control. It can be used for early defense, yes, but due to its low firerate, it might leak faster enemies. Paintballer Paintballer is, well, quite useful until above wave 9. Then its usefulness drops harder than Battlefield 2042's player count. Its higher levels is just isnt that cost efficient, and its explosion radius is... small. But hey, it is as cheap as it gets. What do you expect D Tier Hunter It is just Sniper, but worse for early game, ground placement, a bit cheaper and costs 850 coins in shop. Nuff said Pyromancer Now with speed up removed, Pyro just feel... meh. It is not exceptionally good, it can be used for early game, but it is just... meh. ROF partically fixed, so defense dropping capability isnt that important anymore. It was good for Frost Invasion, i guess. You can get some better tower with 2000 coins Golden Pyro Pyromanacer, but more range, and costs around 52000 coins to 302000 coins, depends on how lucky you are. Nuff said C Tier Sniper After the rework, Sniper have became quite decent for early game, can easily take out the stronger enemies. It can also be useful for the Duck Hunt event due to the higher amout of low health flying enemies, which Sniper's cheap price makes it spammable to counter them, and some dude on Youtube got to wave 50 in Hardcore with it, so it can be used for Hardcore, i guess. Scout. It is your starter tower in the game, and it fits that role perfectly. It can carry you thru the early games, somewhat mid game, and thats it. It is not OP or anything, it is just middle-of-the-road Cowboy Ah Cowboy Cowboy Cowboy. The poor Cowboy. It should be in the roles of both a defend and a economic tower, but it failed at both. Its preformance is quite... bad for what you paid for, and its money output, if spammed, could be viable, but you better off using the Farm and another better tower for early defense. Not to mention how hard it is to obtain Cowboy really hinders its usefulness Crook Boss This tower is just... Militant, but worse. Its Lv4 is quite overpriced, its spawns are weak, and the 4 placement limit doesnt help much. Lv3 spams can be good for early game tho. B Tier Military Base This tower.... is...quite of a wild card for me. For early game, its spawm rate make it not a very viable choice for early game. For mid game, its decent, i guess. For late game, it is quite... overpriced. 26000 for around 100 DPS and it is not consistant.
